The Mg2Fe12N12 structure (Mg(FeN)6) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe and Mg centers in octahedral environments coordinated by six N neighbors, while N centers show three geometric neighbors (two Fe, one Mg). Corner-sharing between Fe octahedra and between Fe and Mg octahedra is observed, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
